preservedResponsibilities: Explicitly user-approved original setAllowedPaths/isForbidden and pre-open ACCES hook are ported with source read/write/execute lists, literal prefix matching, empty-read bypass, parent/realpath recursion, partial setup and abort environment order. Native openFilePath uses actual libc/MEMFS flags, open/stat/optional F_SETLK/cleanup and original handle state. Full active Forbidden::forbidden QA assertions and real create/truncate/exclusive/read-only/permissions/symlink/abort integration are exercised. Native pointer overread/OOM, SAL diagnostic/debug and other OS profiles remain unqualified; URL entry points, SvFileStream/TempFile/package/model/filter/UI acceptance remain unfinished.
omittedResponsibilities: File URL entry points, SvFileStream/TempFile, complete package/storage/model/filter/UI; SAL diagnostics/debug and native invalid-pointer/OOM/other OS profiles.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original file.cxx access-list responsibility is split from native buffered IO/open implementation to keep source ownership and file-size boundaries. No stronger sandbox rule or alternative filesystem is substituted.
